blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A single validation-tuned threshold can become brittle when dense-score distributions shift. We introduce AutoThreshold, a post-hoc policy that predicts the joint mass of positive and negative pixels over score bins. This target directly parameterizes threshold-indexed confusion counts, avoiding products of independently estimated prevalence and class-conditional rates. Softmax normalization and cumulative decoding yield coherent, monotone confusion profiles; a plug-in decoder then selects a threshold for any $F_β$ objective without retraining the head. Across three independently trained Kvasir pipelines transferred to four polyp datasets, Joint exceeds continuous Otsu by $0.0080 \pm 0.0046$ external macro Dice, with positive gains in 3/3 runs. On the reference pipeline, three head seeds achieve $0.6324 \pm 0.0027$, 0.0085 above Otsu; direct-utility Ridge achieves 0.6342, with the paired difference interval spanning zero. The same Joint checkpoints outperform Otsu for $F_{0.5}$, Dice, and $F_2$. On developmental KITTI Road leave-one-corruption-family-out evaluation, Joint improves over scalar regression by 0.0082 [0.0064, 0.0101], while direct utility is 0.0022 higher. These results establish joint confusion prediction as a useful, metric-retargetable inductive bias, without claiming Bayes-optimal $F_β$ decisions.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision models produce continuous scores, but deployed systems ultimately act on discrete masks. The binarization threshold directly trades false positives against false negatives, yet it is commonly fixed once on source validation data. That choice ignores image- and domain-dependent changes in score calibration, score shape, and foreground prevalence—precisely the changes encountered after deployment.
blocks.zh: 视觉模型产生连续分数,但部署的系统最终作用于离散口罩. 二进制阈值直接将假正值与假正值进行交易,但通常在源验证数据上固定一次. 这种选择忽略了在分数校正、分数形状和前景普遍度方面依图像和域位而定的变化——确切地说就是部署后遇到的变化。

blocks.en: Adaptive thresholding is well established in low-level image processing [ 23 ] , and task-specific systems adapt training or post-processing thresholds in object detection and crowd localization [ 19 , 27 , 30 , 9 ] . Learned mask binarization, however, presents a specific supervision choice. Regressing one tie-broken optimum discards the utility landscape: two equally distant errors can incur very different regret. Regressing every sampled utility is a principled finite-action value estimator, but it imposes no structure across neighboring thresholds and must be retrained when the target metric changes.
blocks.zh: 适应性阈值在低等图像处理[23]中早已确立,任务特定系统在对象检测和人群本地化[19,27,30,9]中调整了培训或后处理阈值. 然而,学习的面具二进制是一个具体的监督选择。 重回一条领带断裂的最佳方式丢弃了公用环境:两个同样相去甚远的错误可能产生非常不同的遗憾. 重回每个抽样效用是一个原则性的限制行动价值估计器,但它没有在邻接阈值之间强加任何结构,在目标计量标准改变时必须重新加以训练。

Binary masks expose exactly such a target. blocks.en: AutoThreshold predicts positive and negative score-bin mass as one normalized distribution. Cumulative decoding enforces monotone confusion-count curves, and a metric decoder selects a threshold for Dice, F 0.5 F_{0.5} , or F 2 F_{2} from the same prediction. An auxiliary loss aligns its score marginal with the observed, label-free histogram. The policy remains fully detached from the segmenter: labels construct offline targets from cached score maps, whereas deployment uses only score-map statistics and a lightweight MLP.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Post-Processing Thresholds High-level vision systems use confidence thresholds to filter predictions and IoU thresholds in both post-processing and evaluation. These roles differ: an NMS overlap threshold controls suppression among predicted boxes [ 2 ] , whereas evaluation IoU thresholds determine whether detections match ground truth [ 17 ] . Figure 1 situates mask binarization in this broader design space. Our joint decoder specifically exploits binary score maps; it does not extend directly to NMS or corpus-level ranking.
blocks.zh: 处理后阈值 高水平视觉系统在处理后和评价中使用置信阈值来过滤预测和IoU阈值. 这些作用不同:在预测的框中,国家监测系统重叠阈值控制抑制,而评价IoU阈值则确定检测是否与地面真理相符[17]。 图1 将遮罩二进制置于这个更广泛的设计空间。 我们的联合编解码器专门利用二进制分数图;它并不直接延伸到NMS或实体级的分数.

blocks.en: Operator-Specific Thresholding Algorithmic methods encode a particular decision rule. Adaptive NMS changes suppression according to local box density [ 19 ] ; DIoU supplies a distance-aware NMS criterion, while the CIoU study incorporates geometric factors into Cluster-NMS [ 31 , 32 ] . Threshold-adaptive focal loss changes how target-domain samples contribute during training [ 29 ] , while classical image methods derive binarization thresholds from intensity statistics [ 23 , 24 ] . These methods exploit operator-specific structure but do not learn a confusion representation that can be decoded for multiple task metrics.
blocks.zh: 运算符-特定径控算术方法编码特定决定规则. 适应性NMS变化抑制根据局部框密度[19];DIoU提供有距离感的NMS标准,而CIoU研究则将几何因素纳入Cluster-NMS [31,32]. 阈值适应性焦点损失改变了目标域样本在培训期间的贡献[29],而古典图像方法则从强度统计中得出二进制阈值[23,24]. 这些方法利用了操作员特有的结构,但没有学会一个可以被解码成多个任务度量的混淆表示.

blocks.en: Learned Threshold Policies Learned threshold methods typically attach adaptation to one task: CPSS-FAT adapts positive-sample selection thresholds during detector training [ 30 ] , Independent Instance Maps learn image-dependent spatial binarization maps for crowd localization [ 9 ] , and Crowd Hat and CTFNet learn region-adaptive NMS or confidence-foresight mechanisms [ 27 , 26 ] . AutoThreshold instead learns a detached mask policy from cached outputs of a specified frozen operator.
blocks.zh: 学习门槛政策 学到的阈值方法通常附加一项任务:CPSS-FAT在探测器训练中适应正样本选择阈值[30],独立 实例地图学习图像依赖的空间二进制地图,用于人群本地化[9],而Crowd Hat和CTFNet学习区域适应性NMS或信心-预见机制[27,26]. 自动屏蔽从指定的被冻结的操作器的缓存输出中学习一个脱开的遮罩策略。

blocks.en: Contextual Decisions and Calibration Post-hoc calibration aligns confidence with empirical correctness [ 11 ] , while selective prediction learns when to abstain at a desired coverage [ 10 ] . They address score reliability or risk–coverage behavior, not per-image mask thresholds for a task metric. Decision-focused learning trains predictions for downstream optimization value [ 4 , 25 ] . We share that motivation but predict threshold-sufficient confusion statistics from cached outputs, requiring neither a differentiable optimizer nor changes to the frozen model.
blocks.zh: 二. 背景决定和校正 后高分校正使信心与实证正确性相配合[11],而有选择性的预测则学习何时在所期望的覆盖范围下弃权[10]. 它们涉及得分可靠性或风险-覆盖行为,而不是任务衡量标准的每个图像口罩阈值。 决策重点学习列车下游优化值预测[4,25]. 我们赞同这一动机,但预测从缓存产出中得出足够临界值的混淆统计数据,既不需要不同的优化器,也不需要改变被冻结的模式。

We include the resulting decision-consistent finite-action estimator as our strongest learned baseline. AutoThreshold instead predicts a metric-independent joint distribution over labels and score bins, sharing cumulative structure across neighboring thresholds.

We use the same dependence of F β F_{\beta} on confusion counts, but at a different decision unit: our head predicts an entire threshold-indexed confusion curve for each frozen score map. blocks.en: 4 Learning Adaptive Threshold Policies

blocks.en: 4.1 Threshold Policy Design
blocks.zh: 4.1 临界政策设计

blocks.en: Before learning a threshold policy, one must specify both its action and its evaluation unit. Figure 1 organizes these choices along three axes.
blocks.zh: 在学习最低限度政策之前,必须说明其行动和评价单位。 图1按三个轴线排列这些选择。

blocks.en: Threshold Type: Thresholds control distinct post-processing decisions. For example, Crowd Hat adapts regional NMS thresholds [ 27 ] , whereas IIM predicts a dense binarization-threshold map for crowd localization [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 阈值类型:阈值控制不同的后处理决定. 例如: 人群 帽会适应区域NMS阈值[27],而IIM预测一个密集的二进制-阈值地图用于人群本地化[9].

blocks.en: Decision Unit: A policy may share one image-wide threshold, predict one threshold per region, or produce a dense threshold field. “Pixel-level” in Figure 1 is the raster-output special case of the last setting. A globally coupled decision, such as suppression, cannot be localized unless its operator is regionalized as well.
blocks.zh: 决策单位:一项政策可共享一个全图像阈值,预测每个区域有一个阈值,或产生密集阈值域. 图1中的“像素级”是最后一个设置的光栅输出特例。 除非其操作者也实现区域化,否则全球协同决定,如压制,不能本地化。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: AutoThreshold is a post-hoc threshold policy, not a replacement segmenter. Its core contribution is a threshold-sufficient joint target: positive and negative score mass yield coherent confusion curves and multiple F β F_{\beta} decisions. Joint prediction avoids products of conditional mean prevalence and class-conditional rates; marginal reconstruction remains soft.

Defining T ​ N ^ j = ∑ b b ^ b − F ​ P ^ j \widehat{TN}_{j}=\sum_{b}\hat{b}_{b}-\widehat{FP}_{j} yields a nonnegative, unit-sum confusion vector. Each score bin contributes to every lower threshold, coupling neighboring decisions through cumulative mass. These geometric, not accuracy, guarantees distinguish Joint from scalar labels and unconstrained utilities.

blocks.en: The experiments identify when adaptation matters. One global threshold suffices on source Kvasir and clean KITTI. Under cross-dataset transfer, Joint exceeds Otsu in all three pipelines and helps most at narrow utility optima. Its reference-pipeline difference from direct utility Ridge has an interval spanning zero; its distinctive benefit is retraining-free metric retargeting, not uniformly higher Dice. Oracle headroom therefore diagnoses when adaptation is worthwhile.
blocks.zh: 实验确定了何时适应才重要。 一个全球阈值就足够了, 在跨数据集传输中,联合超过 大津在三条管线上,在狭长的效用上最有帮助。 其参考管与直接公用管相差的间隔为零;其显著的好处是无再培训的计量重定向,而不是统一高的二极管. 因此,甲骨文头室诊断何时值得适应。

blocks.en: Developmental KITTI provides a complementary boundary case: LOCO removes the evaluated corruption family from every outer split, and Joint improves over scalar regression but trails direct utility. Because these synthetic transformations informed method development, the evidence supports generalization across predefined families, not arbitrary real-world shift or independent confirmation.
blocks.zh: 发展型 KITTI提供了一个互补的界限案例:LOCO从每一个外分解中消除了被评价的腐败家族,联合公司在平面回归方面有所改进,但直接发挥了作用。 因为这些合成变相的知情方法发展,证据支持跨越被预先定义的家族的通俗化,而不是任意的现实世界转变或独立确认.

blocks.en: Equation ( 1 ) marks a methodological boundary. Image-, patch-, and dense-level policies require operator and utility to decompose at the same level; corpus ranking metrics and coupled operators such as NMS require groupwise decisions. Within this scope, AutoThreshold offers an auditable route from frozen score maps to adaptive masks while exposing the trade-off between structured plug-in estimation and direct value learning.
blocks.zh: 方程 (1) 标志着一个方法边界. 图像、补丁和密度级政策要求操作员和用户在同一级别进行分解;实体排名指标和组合操作员,如NMS,需要分组决定。 在这一范围内,AutoStreshold提供了从被冻结分数图到适应口罩的可审计路线,同时暴露出结构化插值估计和直接价值学习之间的取舍.
